title: Pier 42 recreational deck opened on the Lower East Side
summary: NYC Parks recorded a November 29, 2022 ribbon cutting for a new 2.8-acre recreational deck at Pier 42, described as an East Side Coastal Resiliency mitigation project with sports and waterfront amenities.
observed_change: A former industrial maritime pier area entered documented public recreational use as a waterfront deck with sports courts, field space, picnic amenities, and public access.
source_name: NYC Parks: NYC Parks Opens New $26 Million Waterfront Space on Lower East Side
source_date_field: NYC Parks press release date and ribbon-cutting statement
architect: NYC Parks, NYCEDC, NYC DDC, Lower Manhattan Development Corporation, and Pier 42 project team
project_type: waterfront recreational deck and public-realm opening
geometry_source: Curated approximate point from Pier 42 / park ID M369 location on the Lower East Side waterfront.
geometry_precision: Approximate pier/park point, not a surveyed deck boundary, field, court, comfort-station footprint, or full waterfront project area.
limitations: The event records the 2022 recreational-deck opening phase only. The manual file already contains the later 2024 final Pier 42 park-phase opening, and the two records should be reviewed together before final import.
duplicate_check_note: Searched manual milestone file and local NYC candidate files for event_id, 'Pier 42 recreational deck', source_record_id, source URL, 'M369', and related Pier 42 terms. The manual file has a related 'Pier 42 final park phase opened' event in 2024 and a 2025 ESCR/Pier 42 esplanade access reference, but no 2022 recreational-deck opening record was found.
source_audit_note: Official NYC Parks page with clear date, public opening/ribbon-cutting language, park identifier, amenities, and city-agency partners. Treat as a phase-specific public-realm event, not as the full Pier 42 completion.
